name: Nancy
source:
Eyes open to an alien world; hostile, painful and frightening.

The only thing to hold onto is a distant voice, always calling the same name.

"... Nancy..." 

[from [url=https://anmanarrative.itch.io/nancy]itch.io[/url]]
